inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at 30 June 2026: 17,983.0m ordinary shares in issue net of ~722m treasury shares held by the share-award trustee (18,705.0m issued) plus 59.4m dilutive restricted-share awards and 7.3m Hygieia consideration shares (interim report note 8). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would double-charge. Buybacks (HK$2bn programme approved June 2026; RMB331m spent in H1 2026) are the mechanism that keeps the count flat and are value-neutral here.
inputs.cash_composition: Cash and bank balances 14,882.1 + non-current bank deposits 7,158.0 + wealth-management products in current FVTPL 12,543.5 = 34,583.6 (the company's own 'fund reserve'); borrowings 8,669.6 current + 8,429.6 non-current = 17,099.2. inputs.interest_income_note: Bank interest income (633.6 in FY2025) is adjusted OUT of profit in the OCF reconciliation and received in INVESTING (FY2025 AR cash-flow statement, 'Interest received 633,592'), as are the Sinovac LS dividend (1,518.7) and investment income (219.6). Reported FCF (OCF less PP&E capex) therefore already excludes all income on the cash pile and investments, so no further deduction is made; the matching assets are in the bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash-flow reconciliation 'Recognition of share-based payments 115,966' (RMB thousands); no equity-award cash taxes disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0). H1 2026 SBC net of tax and NCI was 68.1 (vs 23.5 in H1 2025), implying a gross FY2026 charge of roughly 0.7% of revenue under the 2024 CT Tianqing incentive scheme.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow 'Repurchase of shares' 110.0; H1 2026 331.4; FY2024 1,252.2. Repurchaser.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows are RMB (CNY); the HKEX quote is HKD. CNYHKD=X 1.1727 from Yahoo Finance, 2026-10-16. Direction: model (CNY) -> quote (HKD), i.e. HKD = CNY x 1.1727. No liquid dual listing exists for a parity check (OTC ADRs only); magnitude check: current_price / 1.1727 gives a CNY price that sits at roughly 18x FY2025 underlying EPS of RMB25.2 cents. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate; re-date it on the next rebuild.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T05:10:56Z intraday HKEX session (volatile; replace at the regular close)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: China 10y CGB ~1.8%, China equity risk premium ~6.5%, beta ~1.0 for a large-cap diversified pharma -> cost of equity ~8.3%; net-cash balance sheet so WACC ~= cost of equity; rounded up to 8.5% for HK-listed China governance/policy discount. Same WACC in all three scenarios: VBP, pipeline and licensing risk are charged in the flows, not stacked on the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: B (leases as operating cost): full lease payment (FY2025 principal 39.9 + interest 4.4 = 44.3, 0.14% of revenue) charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (72.2 at 30 Jun 2026) EXCLUDED from total_debt; da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 1,211.6 total less 77.6 ROU = 1,134 = 3.6%).
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged ONCE, in the flows: cash_tax_rate_path is a combined cash-tax-plus-NCI-leakage rate. Cash tax ~19% of EBIT (FY2025 tax paid 1,604 on underlying PBT ~7.5bn ex fair-value losses; H1 2026 16.3% effective; CT Tianqing at the 15% high-tech rate, holdco WHT on top) and NCI ~45% of after-tax operating profit (NCI/(NCI + underlying attributable): FY2024 45%, FY2025 40%, H1 2026 45%; CT Tianqing ~60% owned is the main profit engine and the TQC3721/rovadicitinib licensor). Combined: 1 - 0.81 x 0.55 = 55.5%. NCI book value (13,677) is NOT deducted in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 modelled EBIT 6,923 x 0.445 = 3,081 attributable operating NOPAT vs underlying attributable profit 4,541 less the Sinovac dividend (1,353 net) and the parent share of net finance/investment income (~300) = ~2,890; within non-operating noise.
inputs.ebitda_basis: Operating EBITDA built from the income statement core lines only: gross profit less S&D, administrative and R&D costs, plus D&A and SBC. EXCLUDES other income (Sinovac dividend 1,518.7, investment income 219.6, grants), other gains/losses (FY2025 fair-value loss 1,671 on non-current FVTPL), other expenses (impairments 426) and share of associates. FY2025: 26,126.7 - 10,993.3 - 2,143.5 - 5,866.2 + 1,211.6 + 116.0 = 8,451 incl. lease cost -> 26.5% of revenue (25.9% after the 0.14% lease charge). H1 2026: 16,147.7 - 5,260.1 - 969.5 - 3,080.0 + ~600 D&A + ~130 SBC = ~7,570 = 38.9%, of which out-licensing upfront ~980 at ~100% margin; ex-licensing ~35.7%. The CSV's reported EBITDA (7,951 FY2025) is NOT the base.
inputs.revenue_mix_note: H1 2026: innovative drugs 7,810 (+29.2%), out-licensing 980 (Sanofi rovadicitinib upfront US$135m; H1 2025: 40), generics/biosimilars 10,655 (-7.2%). Headline +10.6%; ex out-licensing +5.3%. H2 2026 carries the AstraZeneca TQC3721 upfront US$200m (~RMB1.43bn). Out-licensing is treated as PARTLY recurring: ~RMB2.4bn of upfronts in FY2026 steps down to ~1.5bn/yr of milestones and new deals in the base, flat-to-growing in the bull, one-off in the bear.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating pharmaceutical company; SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US' with the adaptations for currency, leases, NCI and excluded income). FRESH BUILD: no prior Drivers/DCF. Horizon 10 years because margins and the innovative/generic mix are still shifting. Reported FCF of 8,053 in FY2025 is consolidated (pre-NCI) and includes a one-off +2,726 increase in other payables/accruals; the component build does not carry either forward. Terminal cap multiple 18x (not 20x) for a China pharma with annual NRDL/VBP repricing. Price is an intraday print.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_3yr_cagr on the continuing-operations basis (FY2022 restated 26,026 -> FY2025 31,834), cross-checked against the H1 2026 ex-licensing product growth of +5.3% and the mix arithmetic (innovative ~42% of product sales growing ~20-29%, generics/biosimilars declining ~5-7% under VBP)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 12.9% vs EPS 5yr CAGR -2.4% and revenue 6.1%: equity jumped in FY2021 on the RMB13.6bn Sinovac LS remeasurement gain, not retained operating earnings; the 3yr equity CAGR (1.0%) is depressed by FY2025 buyouts of minorities and dividends. Neither equity figure is a usable growth proxy. FCF CAGRs (~16%) are flattered by the FY2025 one-off working-capital inflow (+2,726 other payables) and are consolidated pre-NCI.
historical_growth.notes: CSV revenue for FY2022 (28,780) includes the operations discontinued in FY2024; the FY2025 five-year summary restates FY2022 continuing revenue at 26,026. Owner FCF = reported FCF less SBC (29.7/18.1/53.7/116.0 for FY2022-25; nil before); interest income is already outside reported FCF (classified in investing). EPS CAGRs use the bonus-issue-adjusted series and reported (not underlying) attributable profit, which carries fair-value noise.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 12.5%: H1 actual +10.6% plus the AZ upfront (~1.43bn) in H2 on ~5-6% product growth. FY2027 4.5%: upfronts (~2.4bn) step down to ~1.5bn of milestones/new deals while product sales grow ~7%. FY2028-30 7%: innovative drugs (~45-50% of product sales by then, ~20 Category-1 approvals targeted 2026-28, GSK in-licensed Trelegy/Anoro/bepirovirsen) outgrow a shrinking generics book. Decelerates to 4% by year 10 as the innovative base matures and NRDL repricing bites.
base.margin_rationale: FY2026 36%: H1 actual 38.9% (35.7% ex-licensing); H2 assumed ~33% incl. the AZ upfront. FY2027 32.5%: licensing drops ~1bn and part of the H1 2026 S&D cut (-18% YoY) is assumed to reverse. Mature 34%: a diversified innovative-led China pharma (Hengrui-like) with S&D ~28%, R&D ~16-17%.
base.tax_rationale: Combined cash tax (~19%) and NCI leakage (~45%) held flat: no evidence the group will buy out CT Tianqing minorities; LaNova/Hygieia are already 100%.
base.wc_rationale: Manufacturer/distributor: receivables (10.7bn) + inventory (2.0bn) exceed trade payables (2.2bn); accruals (15.3bn) offset much of it. -10% of the revenue change consumed.

bull.rationale: Out-licensing becomes a genuinely recurring 3-4bn/yr stream (milestones, royalties, 1-2 new global deals a year), innovative drugs sustain 25%+ growth through the 2026-30 approval wave, GSK in-licensed brands add 1-2bn, and the H1 2026 cost structure holds -> margins expand to 38%.

bear.rationale: The 2026 upfronts are one-offs (FY2027 revenue falls as ~2.4bn of licensing drops out), further VBP/NRDL rounds take generics down 8-10%/yr and reprice the anlotinib/PD-1 franchises, innovative growth slows to low-teens as late-stage assets stumble, and the S&D cut reverses -> margins back to the FY2025 level (25%). Terminal cap 14x for a repriced China pharma.

scenario_narratives.base: SBP Group is halfway through a mix shift: innovative drugs (42% of H1 2026 product sales) are growing ~29% while the VBP-exposed generics/biosimilar book (58%) shrinks ~7%, netting to ~5-6% product growth that rises toward 7% as the mix tips. On top sits a new but lumpy out-licensing stream (Sanofi rovadicitinib, AstraZeneca TQC3721) whose 2026 upfronts (~RMB2.4bn) will not repeat at that size; the base keeps ~1.5bn/yr of milestones and new deals. The H1 2026 margin step-up (S&D -18%) is assumed to partly hold, taking operating EBITDA to a mature 34%. Roughly 45% of after-tax operating profit leaks to CT Tianqing's minorities, charged in the flows. The balance sheet (RMB17.4bn net cash plus ~RMB11bn of investments after haircut) is about a third of the market value.
scenario_narratives.bull: The 2026-30 approval wave (~30 Category-1 drugs) plus the GSK in-licensed respiratory and liver brands keeps product growth near 10%, China-origin licensing deal flow makes out-licensing a recurring RMB3-4bn/yr line with royalties layering in from 2028+, and the leaner commercial model holds so margins reach 38%. Policy (pillar-industry status, commercial-insurance catalogue, pricing reform) favours innovators over generics.
scenario_narratives.bear: VBP and NRDL negotiations hit both the generics tail and the maturing anlotinib/PD-1 franchises, late-stage pipeline failures slow innovative growth to low-teens, the licensing upfronts prove one-off so FY2027 revenue falls, and S&D normalises back up. US-China biotech tension curtails further global deals. Margins revert to the FY2025 25% level and the terminal multiple caps at 14x. Even then the cash and investment pile limits the downside.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: the growth story rests on an unproven recurrence of licensing income, a single policy regime (VBP/NRDL) reprices the whole book annually, and the H1 2026 margin step-up has one half-year of evidence. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs pipeline, licensing cadence and the cost structure to all hold simultaneously. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the operating pharma business on attributable owner FCF (NCI leakage and cash tax charged once in the flows, SBC expensed, leases as operating cost) in CNY at a CNY-built 8.5% WACC, then add the matching non-operating assets (cash, deposits, wealth-management products, the Sinovac FVOCI stake at a 20% haircut, FVTPL investments and associates at book) whose income was stripped from the flows, and convert to HKD at 1.1727. Out-licensing upfronts are treated as partly recurring; the scenarios differ mainly on licensing recurrence, VBP severity and whether the H1 2026 cost structure holds.
key_risks_to_valuation: Out-licensing recurrence: ~RMB2.4bn of 2026 upfronts at ~100% margin; if no further deals/milestones follow, FY2027 revenue and margin step down more than the base assumes
VBP/NRDL repricing of the generics/biosimilar book (58% of product sales) and of maturing innovative franchises (anlotinib, penpulimab)
NCI leakage: ~45% of operating profit accrues to CT Tianqing and other subsidiary minorities; any change in subsidiary ownership moves per-share value materially
Sustainability of the H1 2026 S&D cut (-18% YoY) that lifted operating margins from ~26% to ~36-39%
Non-operating assets: Sinovac LS stake (RMB7.2bn, Level-3 fair value) and RMB12.5bn of wealth-management products; fair-value marks and dividend timing are volatile (FY2025 FV loss 1.67bn)
Currency: CNY flows against an HKD quote; fx_rate is dated and not refreshed by price refreshes
Pipeline execution across dozens of late-stage assets and integration of LaNova/Hygieia
Intraday price print; HK biotech sentiment swings are large (52-week range 4.19-7.79)
